planets.name: DS Tuc A b
planets.description: Transiting planet of DS Tuc A with a 8.14-day year, found in 2019.

text.card: DS Tuc A b was found in 2019 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around DS Tuc A. Its orbit and size follow Newton et al. 2019's fit, the archive's default.
